questions.stem_text:
Which living organisms most resemble the common ancestor of all life according to genetic
testing?

options.C: organisms living deep in the oceans around seafloor volcanic vents and in hot springs
options.D: plankton that use sunlight as an energy source through photosynthesis

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - organisms living deep in the oceans around seafloor volcanic vents and in hot springs

questions.stem_text: You cool a blackbody to half its original temperature. How does its spectrum change?

options.A: Power emitted is 1/16 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 1/2 as long.
options.B: Power emitted is 1/4 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 2 times longer.
options.C: Power emitted is 1/4 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 1/2 as long.
options.D: Power emitted is 1/16 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 2 times longer.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Power emitted is 1/16 times as high; peak emission wavelength is 2 times longer.
